facts.text: Raffles Hainan Clear Water Bay sits on Hainan's southern shore, facing the Gulf of Tonkin and Vietnam.
facts.excerpt: Nestled in lush tropical palms on its southern shore, facing the Gulf of Tonkin and Vietnam, Raffles Hainan Clear Water Bay enjoys a glorious climate

facts.text: The resort's beach is known as the Singing Beach because of the sound its soft white sand makes underfoot.
facts.excerpt: Our beach is known as the Singing Beach because of the special sound the soft, pure white sand makes when people step on it.

facts.text: The resort combines light, open Balinese-style architecture with an authentic local feel.
facts.excerpt: combining light, open Balinese-style architecture with an authentic local feel

facts.text: Bai Wei has five private dining rooms set in individual pavilions overlooking the resort's lotus ponds.
facts.excerpt: Take your seat in one of five elegant private dining rooms set in individual pavilions overlooking our lotus ponds.

facts.text: Bai Wei serves Cantonese, Hunan and Szechuan cuisines, along with signature dishes and Hainan specialties.
facts.excerpt: Bai Wei Dining showcases Cantonese, Hunan, and Szechuan cuisines, along with signature dishes and Hainan specialties.

facts.text: The name Bai Wei means 'a hundred flavours'.
facts.excerpt: a specialism reflected in the name Bai Wei which means 'a hundred flavours'

facts.text: Guests are looked after by traditional Raffles Butlers.
facts.excerpt: Your stay is infused with the generous attentiveness of our traditional Raffles Butlers

facts.text: The resort has a lagoon pool, a lap pool and two Jacuzzis, surrounded by tropical gardens.
facts.excerpt: Surrounded by lush tropical gardens, dive into our lagoon pool, lap pool and two Jacuzzis.

facts.text: The spa is a retreat of over 1,400 square metres whose design incorporates attributes of Hainan Island.
facts.excerpt: discover a sensory retreat of over 1400 sq m, incorporating the unique attributes of Hainan Island in its design

facts.text: Bespoke spa days of two, three or five hours include a snack or lunch at Raffles Spa.
facts.excerpt: a journey of two, three or five hours to suit your individual needs and desires. These can be made up of any combination of treatments or sessions from our full menu, and include a healthy and nutritious snack or lunch at Raffles Spa.

facts.text: The resort can introduce guests to members of Hainan's Li ethnic minority to explore their culture.
facts.excerpt: During your stay we would love to introduce you to members of these ancient ethnic tribes and explore their culture.

facts.text: The resort's heritage is strongly influenced by the Li, an ethnic minority group on Hainan Island.
facts.excerpt: Our heritage is strongly influenced by the Li, a unique group of ethnic minorities who have lived on Hainan Island for 1,000 years.

facts.text: A three-night Clear Water Bay safari package includes a helicopter flight over the beach and a two-hour private yacht charter around the bay.
facts.excerpt: Take a helicopter flight over the gentle crescent of our famous beach; board a private charter for a two-hour yacht sail around the deep blue bay

facts.text: Golf can be arranged at the neighbouring course, including driving-range practice or a lesson with the pro.
facts.excerpt: Let us arrange for you to play, spend practice time at the driving range or organise a lesson with the pro.

facts.text: Fully supervised day or half-day activity sessions are offered for families.
facts.excerpt: Fully supervised day or half-day sessions, packed with activity to suit your family's needs.

facts.text: Family Rooms are themed and equipped for children aged 12 and under.
facts.excerpt: The diversified themes, colorful setup and facilities are designed for children who are 12-years-old and younger.

facts.text: The Junior Bay Pool Suite has a private pool reached directly from the balcony.
facts.excerpt: access private pool directly from the balcony

facts.text: Premium Pool Villas have a private garden and private swimming pool with views of the golf course.
facts.excerpt: private garden in a tropical style. Enjoy the private swimming pool with views of the verdant golf course.

facts.text: Activities include personal training, yoga, tennis and swimming classes for all ages, plus beach volleyball and football.
facts.excerpt: Personal training, yoga, tennis and swimming classes for all ages, along with beach volleyball and football.

facts.text: The resort suggests October to April as the ideal time to visit, when the weather suits beach activities.
facts.excerpt: The ideal time is from October to April when the weather is pleasant and perfect for beach activities.

facts.text: The resort's address is Clearwater Bay Avenue, Yingzhou Town, Lingshui County, Hainan.
facts.excerpt: Clearwater Bay Avenue, Yingzhou Town, Lingshui County, 572427 Hainan, China

facts.text: There is a 790 square metre flexible space for meetings, events and weddings.
facts.excerpt: A 790 sq m flexible space for meetings, events and weddings

facts.text: The resort claims the best beach on Hainan.
facts.excerpt: enjoys a glorious climate and the best beach on the island – some say in the whole of China

facts.text: The resort says there are only three Singing Beaches in the world.
facts.excerpt: There are only three Singing Beaches in the world – in Hawaii, Australia's Gold Coast and Hainan's Clear Water Bay.
